market.question: Will Natural Gas (NG) hit (LOW) $2.60 in May?

assessment.reasoning: NG at ~$2.82 on May 5, 2026, near 4-week high but recent 1.5-year low. Storage 7.1% above 5-yr avg, mild spring weather bearish. Need ~7.8% drop to $2.60. With 24 days, probability moderate.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Production cuts could support prices; weather shifts.
